adapter.rate_note: Anonymous Opendatasoft quota answered on 2026-09-25 as X-RateLimit-Limit: 2000000 per day (reset 00:00 UTC); records endpoint: limit ≤ 100 and offset+limit < 10000. Five requests per second.
adapter.terms: BOAMP data (DILA) under the Licence Ouverte / Etalab; responses are submitted on the buyer's profile platform named in the notice, not through this API.

search_postings.note: GET /api/explore/v2.1/catalog/datasets/boamp/records (Opendatasoft Explore API v2.1, linked from https://www.boamp.fr/pages/api-boamp/). `query` is sent as a quoted ODSQL string literal in `where` ('a simple full-text search'), e.g. toiture vichy → where="toiture vichy"; a double quote inside the query breaks the clause (ODSQLSyntaxError). `category` refines on the descripteur_libelle facet (exact French label, e.g. Maîtrise d'oeuvre, Bâtiment, Prestations de services). Newest first (order_by dateparution desc). The dataset holds every BOAMP notice type — contract notices, award results, corrections — check raw.nature_categorise_libelle ('Avis de marché' = open call) and deadline (datelimitereponse). min_budget is not sent (no amount field). offset+limit must stay below 10000. id is the BOAMP idweb (e.g. 26-91551).

get_posting.note: GET /records?where=idweb="<id>"&limit=1 — the dataset's GET /records/{record_id} takes the internal record id, not the BOAMP number, so the notice is fetched by filtering on idweb. An unknown idweb returns no record (invalid_input). The full notice (eForms / legacy XML converted to JSON) is in raw.donnees and raw.gestion as JSON strings.

not_offered.me: Anonymous open-data API; no account to verify.
not_offered.submit_bid: Read-only open-data API; tenders are submitted on the buyer's profile platform (raw.donnees/url_avis give the link).
not_offered.list_messages: No messaging; the Explore API only supports GET over datasets.
not_offered.send_message: No messaging; 'Only the HTTP GET method is supported.'
not_offered.credits: No account or credit endpoint; the quota is reported in X-RateLimit-* headers only.
